items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: He had Metcalf, he had Roy Eldridge... Teddy had a really gorgeous book, with Roy Eldridge, you know, and Chu Berry... He had a nice little band

ctx.x: Because, you know, Dunbar Palace we'd play on weekends, maybe a day, or maybe a dance... They had many social clubs in those days. And at the Renaissance, I mean, you had... Vernon always had a dancing band. He had Metcalf, he had Roy Eldridge...
What sort of music did the Louisiana Stompers play?
